section: Safety hazard: moving appliances supported on a wheeled base
markdown:
| Danger                                                                | Where or in what situations does the hazard arise?     | Preventative action                                                  |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Risk of crushing of body parts                                        | While appliances are being moved on a wheeled platform | When servicing, engage the parking brake on the wheels               |
| Risk of hands and feet being pinched Risk of electric shock from live | While appliances are being moved on a wheeled platform | Disconnect the appliance from the electrical supply before moving it |
